title: Preselect Vs Select Events And Chrome
description: Separate preselect (rectangle/lasso drag) from committed select; preselect secondary = anchor minus preselect; preselectCancel on Escape; onPreselect/onPreselectCancel events in TS.
summary: Split rectangle/lasso preview from committed selection: WASM keeps `selection` until pointer-up, drives preview via `preselect` + `preselect_removed` (anchor \ preselect) for secondary chrome, and emits `preselect` / `preselectCancel` instead of `select` during drag. Commit applies exit highlight once and emits `select`. TS adds BoardPreselectSnapshot, BoardEventMap.preselect/preselectCancel, onPreselect/onPreselectCancel/usePreselect, and routes text/2D secondary styling through preselectRemovedIds while area-selecting.
